snippet.title: Skyblocker Release Trailer - Pitchfork Games
snippet.description:
Skyblocker is AVAILABLE NOW on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474920/Skyblocker

Stack your tower as high and as fast as you can in Skyblocker, an infinitely fun and replayable physics-based 3D puzzle game. Battle the elements and gravity, compete for a place on the online leaderboards, unlock tons of cosmetics and unique levels, or relax in Zen mode.

"If Jenga and Tetris had a physics based love child, Skyblocker would be it" - Higher Plain Games

BUILD YOUR TOWER AS HIGH AS YOU CAN

Skyblocker's advanced scoring system accounts for a broad range of factors such as your multiplier, average block placement time, and how high your tower reaches, just to name a few. Play and compete for a high score with global online leaderboards!

DON'T LET YOUR TOWER FALL

Skyblocker's realistic physics means that the wonkier your tower, the more likely it is to collapse. Ten faults and you're out, but even failure can be satisfying as you watch your monumental structure crumble and tumble!

BATTLE THE ELEMENTS

Looking for an extra challenge? Skyblocker's optional dynamic weather includes thunderstorms and blizzards with winds that could blow your tower over! If you revel in a challenge, you can try to withstand the storm in our "Severe" weather mode.

UNIQUE LEVELS & UNLOCKABLE COSMETICS

There are a total of six unique playable levels, and dozens of gorgeous in-game unlockable block skins, so you can customize your blocks with your favorite look!
